title: December Pre-K Day at 4Roots Farm
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: Presented by Nemours Children’s Health Give your little one the chance to learn, play, and experience adventures in agriculture with 4Roots Pre-K Days, a monthly program designed just for preschool-aged children (ages 3–5) and their caregivers! In partnership with Nemours Children’s Health, this series introduces children and families to agricultural and nutrition concepts through sensory-rich, play-based experiences that spark curiosity about food, farming, and the environment. Each Session Features 📖 Storytime: A thoughtfully chosen picture book connected to the month’s theme 🥕 Snack: A wholesome, theme-inspired treat 🎨 Activity: A guided craft or hands-on activity that encourages creativity, fine motor skills, and discovery By blending reading, food, and nature-based play, children and caregivers can enjoy meaningful time together while building early learning skills.   🐾 December’s Theme Learn more about all the creatures, big and small, that call our farm home by reading Whose Prints? by Kari Allen. Explore the different clues animals leave behind, compare your own prints to animals big and small, and get ready for hibernation with a nourishing snack.

title: Sourdough Starter Workshop
description: Create your own sourdough starter while learning the basics of sourdough baking in this beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop. You’ll build a sourdough starter from scratch, explore the basics of fermentation, and create your own sourdough loaf to bake at home. $40

title: Homeschool Day at 4Roots Farm (Ages 8-11)
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: The 4Roots Homeschool Days program brings learning to life through hands-on experiences in the garden and beyond. Through seasonal, interactive activities, students explore agriculture and the environment in a way that encourages curiosity, creativity, and real-world connection. Designed for a range of ages, our program blends playful discovery with meaningful learning as students dive deeper into agriculture and related sciences. Each experience is designed to build practical skills while fostering a greater understanding of sustainability, engineering, and the natural world. December | Agriculture Around the World Learn about the Agricultural revolution and all the different ways agriculture came to be. Students will explore early crops, the first domesticated animals, and discover the techniques our ancestors used to plant, harvest, and thrive. Session activities: 🌿Simulate life as a hunter and gatherer 💧Learn about early irrigation methods in the Fertile Crescent 🐑 Explore early domestication of animals and the value they provided 🪷Experiment with alternative agricultural practices and create their own chinampa (floating garden) or hanging garden.

title: Origin | Splendor
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: Origin invites guests to experience not simply what is on the plate, but everything that came before it. Nestled among the gardens and fields of the 4Roots Farm Campus, Origin is an intimate dining experience where the story of every remarkable meal begins. In partnership with a celebrated guest chef, a local farmer, and 4Roots’ Chef Hari Pulapaka, each dinner is a unique exploration of the season—never repeated, and rooted in what the land has to offer at that moment. Origin is more than fine dining. It is an invitation to experience food with a deeper sense of wonder. Not simply where food is served. But where its story begins. This Month’s Theme & Featured Chef Origin: Splendor is an elegant celebration of winter abundance and the extraordinary diversity of Florida’s seasonal harvest. This one-night-only dining experience features acclaimed Chef Lordfer “Lo” Lalicon , Executive Chef and Co-Owner of the Michelin Green Star restaurant Kaya. Event Details Date: Thursday, December 10th Location: 4Roots Farm Campus – Food Forest Lawn + Barn Time: 6:00pm – 9:00pm Tickets: $175 per guest. Each ticket purchase supports local farms and the mission of 4Roots to create greater food access and education in our community.

title: Festive Foliage: A Holiday Wreath Arranging Class
location: 4Roots Farm Campus, 1101 N. John Young Parkway, Parkway Orlando
description: Presented by Flowers by 4Roots Join us for a festive holiday event at 4Roots Farm! Learn the art of wreath making with Flowers by 4Roots Lead Designer, Haley Hine. With guided instruction, you will work with fresh Christmas greens and holiday accents to design a beautiful wreath, a perfect way to celebrate the holiday season. Plus, come early to enjoy our December Farmers Market! What’s Included: 🌿 Guided Instruction – Learn design basics from an experienced florist, including color theory, composition, and care tips. ✂️ All Materials Provided – Each guest will receive Christmas greens, accents, and all the tools needed to create a one-of-a-kind holiday wreath. 🌲 Take-Home Wreath – Leave with your own custom holiday wreath to brighten your home or gift to a loved one. ☕️ Light Bites & Refreshments – Enjoy hot cocoa, festive cookies, and charcuterie as you create your masterpiece. 🧺 Farmer’s Market (9AM–1PM) – Come early to enjoy the December Farmers Market.
